summary: Implemented SprintHeader and SprintScopeSummary for active, no-active, and closed sprint states. Header now surfaces sprint identity, status, phase/task totals, active blockers, active agents, and closeout state; scope summary links phase progress, scoped task/evidence/verification counts, and phase blocker status. Added route wiring, styles, and component coverage.
command: pnpm check; pnpm test -- tests/runtime/console-components.test.tsx tests/runtime/console-app.test.tsx; pnpm console:build; pnpm test; git diff --check; pnpm console:smoke -- --mode fixture --out .boreal/results/console-route-smoke.json; pnpm console:browser-smoke -- --mode fixture --out .boreal/results/console-browser-smoke.json; pnpm console:render -- --mode fixture --route /sprint --out .boreal/results/console-sprint-fixture.html
